mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees under overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with a Full Moon overhead, and we are expecting an overnight low of 35 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Residents should note that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, with the first installment due by January 31, and candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available at the City Clerk's office with a filing deadline of January 5.
There is plenty to do around town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, followed by the ART House 360 Thursday night festivities and Hop Haus Trivia, also occurring tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot led to the arrest of a 34-year-old driver for operating while intoxicated with a minor in the vehicle.
Today's flavor was Dark Chocolate Decadence, but since the restaurant is closed for the evening, please look forward to tomorrow's flavor when doors open at 10:00 AM.
